About Prashant Yadav: a software developer from India who builds complex, high-performance systems.
Specialties: voice AI, Go microservices, full-stack web development, and cloud-native infrastructure.
He enjoys developing ambitious applications, instant coffee, and watching Anime.
Frontend skills: React, Next.js, Redux, TailwindCSS, Shadcn/UI, Framer Motion.
Backend skills: Go (Gin, Chi), Node.js, Express, Spring Boot, Bun, Deno, Hono.
Databases: MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Drizzle, Prisma, Supabase, Firebase, Redis.
DevOps and deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, AWS, Azure, Vercel, Render, Cloudflare, Fly.io, Railway.

AI / GenAI: LLM integration, RAG pipelines, voice bots (NLU, TTS, STT, VAD), Groq, OpenAI, Gemini, Deepgram, Elevenlabs, Cerebras.
Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Java, C++, C, Python, Bash.
You can view his resume at /resume.pdf and reach him through the /contact page.

Work Experience: Prashant worked as Software Developer Intern at Walmart (May 2026 - July 2026).
What he did: Built a data migration pipeline to reliably transfer and validate large datasets across internal systems. Developed AI agent skills powered by the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that autonomously pull and correlate logs and metrics from OpenObserve, Grafana, and Prometheus. Engineered pod-level diagnostics and automated report generation to surface root causes and accelerate incident debugging with minimal manual intervention. Drove cloud cost-optimization efforts across internal services, identifying and eliminating unnecessary resource spend.

Technologies and tools: Java / Spring Boot, Python, Kubernetes, WCNP, MCP, AI Agents / LLMs, OpenObserve, Grafana, Prometheus, Cloud Cost Optimization.
Company website: https://walmart.com

Work Experience: Prashant worked as Engineering Intern at Nugget (Dec 2025 - Feb 2026).
What he did: Architected end-to-end ticketing logic for LLM-powered voice bots, automating issue capture, classification, and resolution. Delivered production voice solutions for Tata1mg and VoloHealth, building automated ticketing pipelines on a scalable multi-tenant architecture. Engineered high-throughput Go microservices integrating Ozonetel dialers to orchestrate SIP/telephony layers for inbound and outbound calls. Developed the backend for a real-time agent-assist interface that surfaced full conversation context during live call handovers.

Technologies and tools: Go, LLMs, Voice Bots, SIP / Telephony, Ozonetel, Microservices, Multi-tenant Architecture, PostgreSQL.
Company website: https://nugget.com

Work Experience: Prashant worked as Engineering Intern at Eternal (June 2025 - Sept 2025).
What he did: Designed and delivered production-grade voice bots end-to-end, owning the full NLU, TTS, STT, and VAD pipeline from architecture to release. Integrated ElevenLabs, Gemini (TTS), Deepgram (STT), and Groq/OpenAI (NLU) into client-facing voice platforms. Built a modular voice-orchestration framework adopted by Zomato Ads to automate customer-support workflows at scale. Established GitOps CI/CD from scratch using GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, and Infrastructure-as-Code on AWS EKS/ECS.

Technologies and tools: Go, Elevenlabs, Gemini, Deepgram, Groq, OpenAI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, AWS EKS/ECS, IaC, NLU / TTS / STT.
Company website: https://eternal.com

Work Experience: Prashant worked as Full Stack Developer (Intern) at UBIQCURE (Aug 2024 - Nov 2024).
What he did: Designed and shipped four production web portals (Landing, User, Health-Management, and School-Management) using React, Node.js, and MongoDB. Optimized Azure CI/CD pipelines with Docker, reducing deployment times and improving overall system reliability. Led a cross-functional team of 6+ engineers using Jira, GitHub, and Agile methodologies to deliver on schedule.
Technologies and tools: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Azure, Docker, CI/CD, Jira, Agile.
Company website: http://ubiqcure.com/

Education: Prashant studied Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at Indian Institute of Information and Technology Lucknow (Aug 2023 - Jun 2027).
Highlights: Coordinator of Web Wing, AXIOS (Techical Club Of IIITL) Senior Member of FOSS Wing, AXIOS (Techical Club Of IIITL)
Institute: https://www.digipen.edu.sg
